command: set -euo pipefail; adb shell input keyevent 26; sleep 8; echo '--- POWER_OFF_STATE ---'; adb shell dumpsys power | grep -E 'mWakefulness=|Display Power: state=' | head -n 10 || true; PID=$(adb shell pidof io.blueeye | tr -d '\r'); test -n "$PID"; adb shell dumpsys activity services io.blueeye | grep -q 'ScannerService'; adb shell dumpsys activity services io.blueeye | grep -q 'isForeground=true'; echo SCREEN_OFF_SCANNER_STILL_RUNNING_PASS; echo '--- ERRORS_WHILE_OFF ---'; adb logcat -d -v brief --pid="$PID" | grep -E 'FATAL EXCEPTION|AndroidRuntime|SecurityException|IllegalStateException|SQLiteException|OutOfMemoryError' && exit 41 || true
